topStories.headline: Anthropic closes record‐shattering IPO
topStories.whatHappened: Anthropic closed its initial public offering at $83 per share, raising roughly $93.5 billion, including a $26 billion concurrent private placement.
topStories.whyItMatters: This massive IPO marks a historic milestone in AI funding, signaling institutional confidence and shifting how AI companies finance growth.
topStories.depth: When an AI company does an IPO that'll fund Elon’s casino–that’s the kind of play that gets real money talking. Anthropic just raised roughly $93 billion, and it’s flooding Silicon Valley with capital.
topStories.whatToSay: Anthropic just IPO’d for almost a hundred billion—no wonder everyone’s talking AI.
_context: 1,127,000,000 Class A shares sold at $83 each
Gross proceeds ~ $93.5 billion, with $91.6 billion to Anthropic
$26 billion private placement to AMD, Google, Microsoft, NVIDIA, others
topStories._selectionReason: Blockbuster financing spree highly relevant to tech-focused guys, backed by reputable coverage.

topStories.headline: Stocks drop ~10%, Fed hike expected next month
topStories.whatHappened: Major US indexes fell nearly 10%, and markets now widely expect the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates at its December meeting.
topStories.whyItMatters: That kind of drop rattles portfolios and raises borrowing costs; pretty much everyone with a 401(k) feels it.
topStories.depth: Ten‑percent plunge? That’s not a bump—it’s a wake‑up for your retirement fund. And yes, the Fed is probably hiking again in December.
topStories.whatToSay: The Fed’s hiking again—my 401(k) just protested.
_context: Fed anticipated to hike short‑term interest rates next month
topStories._selectionReason: Direct impact on wallets, confirmed across major outlets, big bar chat fodder.

topStories.headline: Talks extend on AI 'killer robot' weapons
topStories.whatHappened: Nations agreed to extend discussions on regulating autonomous weapons today, without committing to binding limits.
topStories.whyItMatters: The ethics and risks of killer AI are finally in global focus—but still no real action. Mostly outrage for now.
topStories.depth: They’re still talking about AI‑guns—14 years, and no rules. It’s kinda wild when discussions outlast solutions.
topStories.whatToSay: Fourteen years of talks on killer robots—and still nothing’s fixed.
_context: Agreed to continue talks, no firm commitments
This is the 14th year of such discussions
topStories._selectionReason: High‑stakes AI ethics keeps making headlines; solid AP coverage.

topStories.headline: Judge halts Trump’s 250‑ft triumphal arch project
topStories.whatHappened: A federal judge issued a preliminary injunction indefinitely halting construction of Trump’s proposed 250‑foot triumphal arch.
topStories.whyItMatters: Trump’s signature public legacy plan just got paused by the courts—no ground‑breaking today.
topStories.depth: Only Trump could make an arch a legal battle. And now the judge says not today—maybe never.
topStories.whatToSay: A 250‑foot Trump arch is now officially paused—judge called it rushed and illegal.
_context: Judge Brinkema issued injunction calling project rushed and legally baseless
Final approval was granted November 5 by a commission stacked with Trump loyalists
Public opinion opposed the arch by more than 2‑to‑1
topStories._selectionReason: Big political news with cultural resonance and solid sourcing.

topStories.headline: AI agents find major zero‑day in medical imaging software
topStories.whatHappened: China‑linked hackers used AI agents to find a zero‑day vulnerability in MONAI Label medical imaging software, gaining full control over a university system.
topStories.whyItMatters: This shows AI isn’t just an invention tool—it’s a hacking weapon too. Healthcare infra is exposed.
topStories.depth: AI hacking medical tools? That’s next‑level scary. Your hospital’s data isn’t safe from smart hackers anymore.
topStories.whatToSay: AI‑powered hackers just breached medical imaging software—total system control. That’s terrifying.
_context: MONAI Label is free software used in medical imaging
Hackers gained full control of a university system
topStories._selectionReason: Chilling cyber‑threat with AI angle, rare and urgent.

topStories.headline: Fundora decision, Jones KO—desert fight card thrills
topStories.whatHappened: Gabriela Fundora retained her undisputed flyweight title via unanimous decision, while Amari Jones scored an 8th‑round TKO over DeAundre Pettus in Indio, California.
topStories.whyItMatters: Jones stays unbeaten and looks title‑ready; Fundora’s streak of KOs ends, but her dominance continues.
topStories.depth: Fundora got the W, but Jones stole the show with that brutal KO. He’s looking like a legit title threat.
topStories.whatToSay: That Jones KO in Round 8? He’s one fight away from a shot at the belt, no joke.
_context: Jones is now mandatory for the IBF middleweight title
topStories._selectionReason: Solid, verified sports highlight with knockouts and title implications.

recPick.title: The high‑wattage e‑MTB that just leveled up with a power bump
recPick.body: It’s Specialized’s flagship electric mountain bike — the S‑Works Turbo Levo 4 — now packing up to 850W of peak power and 111 Nm torque thanks to a free over‑the‑air firmware update that dropped this week. Riders are buzzing about the instant boost in pedal assistance and refined control via rider‑matched MicroTune; plus, holiday pricing has slashed its sticker price by around $2–$2.5 K, making this elite ride suddenly more within reach. But at around $9K on sale, it’s still a wallet‑punishing investment, and a few users have flagged issues like noisy front brakes or gear failures early on — not something you want mid‑trail.
